title: nassella nardoides
intro: Nassella nardoides, commonly known as Sideoats Grama, is a species of grass native to the Great Plains of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Nassella nardoides include its potential to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
